title: Solar Front Identification: Code and Data

creators.name: Podladchikova, Olena
creators.affiliation: National Technical University of Ukraine, Igor Sikorsky Kyiv Polytechnic Institute; Leibniz Institute for Astrophysics Potsdam (AIP)

description:
Python code and data for Identifying Solar and Heliospheric Fronts With Conservation Laws and the MHD Riemann Problem, by Olena Podladchikova.

The program tests three single-front plasma-state pairs, builds three connected MHD wave systems, and compares model predictions with Solar Orbiter, SUVI and AIA observations. It reproduces the numerical checks, seven article figures and four supporting movies.

Extract the archive and open README.md. Install the required Python packages with python -m pip install -r requirements.txt, then run python run.py all. Open results/SUMMARY.md to see the results and links to figures and movies. To make only the movies, run python run.py animations. The supplied data are included; no observation download or account is needed. FFmpeg is optional for MP4 output; GIF output does not require it.

Version 1.1.0 adds the movies and their additional image sequences. The numerical solver, physical checks, original plasma inputs and numerical reference results are unchanged from version 1.0.0. The coronal states are prescribed; the image comparisons do not establish an observed complete wave fan. Data sources and interpretation are explained in docs/DATA.md and docs/ANIMATIONS.md.

The code uses Apache-2.0. Observations retain their original terms, including CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO for Solar Orbiter MAG and SWA data. See NOTICE for credits and data-use terms.
